clipes_EP04.bloco1_quarto_atender_15s: 3D animated feature film style. One character only: the young man from @image1 (white linen shirt rolled sleeves, floral rose tattoo sleeve on his RIGHT forearm), in the bedroom from @image2 at night. Shot 1 (0-5s): extreme close-up of his right hand holding a smartphone in the dark; his thumb hovers over the screen and then slides to answer; cold white screen glow rims his fingers and the tattoo; very shallow depth of field; nearly static with an imperceptible slow push-in. Shot 2 (5-10s): medium shot from the foot of the bed, he sits on the edge with the phone raised to his ear, head slightly bowed; lamp off, only cold blue window light; slow dolly in. Shot 3 (10-15s): close-up on his face from the window side, phone at his ear, blurred orange harbour lights bokeh behind the glass; his worried expression softens into a small involuntary half-smile that he immediately hides. Mood: quiet dread, sleepless night. Teal-blue key light, cinematic volumetric light, subtle film grain, stable camera. No on-screen text, no logos.
clipes_EP04.bloco2_flashbacks_15s: Same style. Warm golden-hour flashbacks, then one cold night shot. Shot 1 (0-5s): the well-dressed man from @image1 on the dirt pitch from @image2 at golden hour, sleeves rolled, laughing, handing a football to two boys in oversized jerseys; kids training behind; a single floodlight pole; he looks like a generous local sponsor, friendly and open, no threat. Slow push-in, warm flare, long shadows. Shot 2 (5-10s): early morning in front of the house from @image3, the same man leaning against the white pickup with the door open; the mother from @image4 at the gate holding his arm in gratitude, offering a folded banknote; he gently pushes her hand down with an open palm smile, refusing the money, then waves goodbye. Shot 3 (10-15s): cut to the night bedroom with the young man from @image0 holding the phone to his ear, face lit only by cold screen light and distant orange harbour bokeh, listening with relief and a faint smile. No on-screen text, no logos.
clipes_EP04.bloco3_quarto_alivio_15s: Same style. One character only: the young man from @image1, in the night bedroom from @image2. Shot 1 (0-5s): close-up of his free hand on the bedsheet, fingers slowly curling and gripping the grey fabric, knuckles relaxing as if a weight lifts; very shallow focus; cold blue rim light on the tattoo of his right forearm. Shot 2 (5-9s): insert of the smartphone held at chest height in the dark, call still connected, screen glow lighting his chin and the collar; blurred orange terminal cranes bokeh behind through the window; camera nearly still with subtle drift. Shot 3 (9-15s): he lies back with hands behind his head, eyes open toward the ceiling, window with distant orange terminal lights on the right; slow pull-back revealing the small empty room, then hold. Mood: quiet relief that is not yet happiness.
clipes_EP04.bloco4_cozinha_15s: Same style. Night kitchen from @image3 with the mother from @image2 and the young man from @image1. Shot 1 (0-5s): medium wide from behind the young man sitting at the wooden table, phone face down beside an enamel mug; his mother stands at the sink with her back to him washing dishes, steam rising; warm tungsten light, quiet domestic stillness, static camera. Shot 2 (5-10s): reverse shot of the mother at the sink in profile, drying her hands on a cloth, thin-framed glasses catching the light, asking without suspicion; shallow focus, slow push-in. Shot 3 (10-15s): the young man facing the camera at the table, a small almost imperceptible smile, phone still face down; he covers it with his palm; hold two beats on the face. Mood: a warm kitchen hiding a first secret.
